review_method: Read all107 actual source units in full, all retained target passages and necessary Exodus19/20/24/34, Numbers25/27/35, Deuteronomy3/10/17/19/28/30, Joshua20/24, Hebrews12, Mark12, Matthew4/22 and Luke4 context. Separately displayed all128 complete source-target-category-rationale combinations for rereading, with a separately reread4:23-25 section after a display truncation. Retained actual Decalogue numbering, differing Sabbath rationales, no-visible-likeness versus face-to-face descriptions, distinct heavenly/earthly speech descriptions, Eastern refuge place forms and source wording mercy at6:25. This is initial curated English-text review, not exhaustive discovery or specialist-language verification.
pin_method: Fresh raw fetch of each of8 source books at the pinned commit, Git blob rehash against existing registries, complete parsed equality with local cache; raw and cache byte normalization distinguished.

editorial_notes.note: Preserve the distinction between no visible likeness and later face-to-face wording, fire on earth and voice from heaven, mercy alongside judgment, actual Sion/Hermon and Asedoth forms, and all three eastern refuge entries. The source comparison does not settle modern place identity.

Actual Deuteronomy5:17adultery/18murder/19theft correspond to Exodus20:13adultery/15murder/14theft. Sabbath rest is grounded in Egyptian deliverance here and creation in Exodus20:11. Covenantal and encounter descriptions remain in their actual forms without harmonization.

Preserve the extended heading at6:4, heart/soul/strength versus NT heart/soul/mind forms, immovable before the eyes, fear/serve/cleave/swear wording versus NT worship/serve-only, Testing, and mercy at6:25. Speakers remain distinguished, including Jesus and the scribe in Mark12.
